claims.text: The initial WTaMoNbV alloy has a BCC crystal structure.
WTaMoNbV can be fabricated by LPBF from mixed elemental powders.
The as-printed LPBF matrix has an approximately 10 µm grain size.
Mixed-powder LPBF WTaMoNbV has approximately 95% density and residual porosity.
The as-printed WTaMoNbV contains unmelted particles.
Mixed-powder LPBF causes severe segregation characterized by W enrichment in grains and V depletion at boundaries.
Replacing mixed elemental powders with pre-alloyed WTaMoNbV powder will ensure chemical homogeneity.
A sequence of hot rolling at 1200 °C with 80% reduction, cold rolling with 75% reduction, annealing at 900 °C, and aging at 650 °C can induce stepwise precipitation.
Processing in pure argon minimizes interstitial contamination.
Aging between 600 and 700 °C stabilizes the proposed precipitates.
The treatment will produce coherent δ-lamellae having a D0a structure.
The treatment will produce coherent γ″ particles having a D022 structure.
Coherent precipitate interfaces facilitate dislocation transmission and relieve stress concentrations, thereby preventing premature crack initiation.
The δ-lamellae strengthen the alloy by impeding dislocation motion at lamellar boundaries.
The γ″ particles provide order hardening and lattice-misfit strengthening.
The combined shearing and pinning mechanisms mitigate brittle fracture caused by interstitial impurities and elemental segregation.
The treated alloy will exceed 2.0 GPa ultimate tensile strength and 10% tensile ductility at room temperature.
The treated alloy will retain more than 1.0 GPa yield strength at 800 °C.
The proposed route will eliminate LPBF porosity and intergranular brittleness associated with mixed-powder segregation.
Mixed-powder LPBF WTaMoNbV has a compressive strength of 1391 MPa and is weaker than its arc-melted counterpart.

contradictions.description: The proposed strategy requires replacing mixed elemental powder with pre-alloyed powder, but the falsification experiment fabricates both treated and control samples from mixed elemental powders. It therefore does not test the complete stated intervention.
